about.title: What is mktba
paragraphs: mktba is an open Islamic wiki. Articles are grouped into sections, and where the schools of Islamic law differ, the opinions of the Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi'i and Hanbali madhabs are shown side by side.

Choose your madhab with the “Madhab” button (in the site header, or at the bottom of the screen on a phone), and articles will open its opinion right away. The other opinions stay on the neighbouring tabs.

feedbackPage.title: Feedback
feedbackPage.intro: Found an error in an article, something does not work, or you have an idea? Write to us. No sign-up needed.
feedbackPage.contactHint: Email, Telegram or another way to reach you. Only the site's editors see the contact; it is never published.
feedbackPage.attachedTitle: What will be sent with the message
feedbackPage.attachedNothing: The page address is unknown. If the message is about a particular page, mention it in the text.
feedbackPage.publicNotice: The message text, page address, article title and madhab go to the project's public issue list on GitHub, where anyone can read them. Do not include personal data in the message. The contact is not included.
